name: DiamondAgentIQ
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why
description: A team of AI agents that helps parents, coaches, players and umpires understand youth baseball and softball calls (umpire judgment vs written rule, with cited rules and code-computed pitch rest) and turns each moment into a lesson and an improvement plan; a post-game mode reviews a box score like a member of the coaching staff.

entry_points.sample_mode: npm run start:sample  or  docker run -e SAMPLE_MODE=true

sponsor_technology.zetaris: All rules, house rules, pitch-rest tiers, coaching lessons, situations, stories, tips and drills are read through Zetaris REST; RulesAgent writes its own read-only SQL.
sponsor_technology.meterless: Nightshift is the primary AI provider (per-agent app streams, compute receipts in every trace); H-MEM is our Meterless Engine, giving each team memory with Critic-driven trust feedback (conformance suite: npm run test:hmem).
sponsor_technology.nvidia: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B and Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B through Nightshift; Claude Code on local Nemotron 3.5 Super (Ollama) during development.
sponsor_technology.cursor: Optional; used for the foundation: scaffold, Zetaris login-token auth, H-MEM vendoring and the Postgres data layer (docs/cursor-build-notes.md).

data: Own-words rule summaries with source links, reviewed by our umpire; team-written coaching content; synthetic tournament rules, drills, games and box scores. No real minors' data.
